in_marathi.name: Sudeepraj
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Good, virtuous, prosperous
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sudeepraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Sudeepraj is derived from the Sanskrit words 'su' meaning good, virtuous, prosperous and 'deep' meaning heart or soul. This name signifies a person with a good heart and a prosperous soul.
